intro: Haɗa kanka zuwa Leafen ɗina, wurin aikina da ƙwaƙwalwata da aka raba, a matsayin sabar MCP (Streamable HTTP), sannan ka taimake ni in fara.
introOnly: Ka haɗa kanka da Leafen na — wurin aikina da ƙwaƙwalwata da aka raba — a matsayin uwar garken MCP (Streamable HTTP).
talk: Yi magana da ni da Hausa, kowace layi — har da gajerun layukan da ke tsakanin kiran kayan aikinka.
plain: Faɗa mini komai da kalmomi masu sauƙi, ba tare da kalmomi irin su OAuth, /mcp ko scope ba.

Idan ku ne haka, ku gaya mini in roƙi mai kula da uwar garken Leafen ya kunna adireshin jama'a sannan in ba ku sabon rubutu.
byCode: Idan za ka iya gudanar da umarni (Claude Code, Codex da sauran wakilai da suke yin haka), haɗa yanzu da wannan lambar ta sau ɗaya — babu shiga kuma babu burauza: umarninka ɗaya da ke ƙasa zai musanya ta da maɓallinka kuma ya saka shi kai tsaye cikin saitunan MCP naka, na kowane babban fayil, don haka maɓallin ba zai taɓa bayyana a wannan tattaunawa ko a kowace fitarwa ba. Lambar tana aiki cikin minti {{minutes}}, sau ɗaya: idan umarninka ya musanya ta amma bai iya ajiye maɓallin a saitunanka ba, sake gudanar da umarnin guda ɗaya — Leafen zai sake musanya lambar yayin da ba a yi amfani da wannan maɓallin ba, kuma wannan maɓallin zai daina aiki. Idan an ƙi ta, ka nemi sabon rubutu a gare ni.
commandsFirst: Umarnin da ke ƙasa suna amfani da adireshin farko; idan ba za ka iya isa gare shi ba, saka origin na adireshin na biyu a cikinsu maimakon.
shells: Kowane umarni yana zuwa sau biyu: na farko don POSIX shell (bash ko zsh — macOS, Linux, Git Bash a Windows), sannan don Windows PowerShell. Gudanar da wanda ya dace da shell ɗin da kayan aikin umarninku ke amfani da shi, daidai yadda yake — kada ku taɓa sake rubuta ɗaya cikin ɗayan.
claudeCode: Claude Code (a tashar umarni ko a cikin manhajar Claude, ɗaya ne):
codex: Codex (cikin config.toml ɗinsa, na kowane babban fayil):
otherAgent: Wani wakili: da farko, idan saitunan MCP ɗinka suna riƙe da sabar a adireshin wannan Leafen tuni, duba shi da kan kai nasa, ba a buga shi ba: GET na asalin adireshin + {{check}} yana amsa 204 lokacin da Leafen har yanzu yake karɓar maɓallinsa don wannan, a matsayina, sannan ka riƙe shi — kada ka musanya komai kuma ka bar lambar (403: bai isa wurare da yawa ba, ko na wani ne — ka bar shi yadda yake kuma ka shiga gefensa; 401: Leafen ya ƙi maɓallinsa). In ba haka ba, yi POST na asalin adireshin + {{path}} da JSON {{json}} — sunan shine yadda kake bayyana a saitunana da kuma a shafukan da kake aiki da su. “key” na amsar ita ce maɓallinka: a cikin wannan umarni ɗaya, ba tare da buga shi ba, saka shi kai tsaye cikin saitunan MCP ɗinka a matsayin sabar MCP mai suna {{name}} (gefen wanda ke da wannan suna tuni, kamar yadda ke ƙasa) a wannan adireshin da kan kai "Authorization: Bearer <key>", don kowane babban fayil. Ka ajiye maɓallin a can kawai, kada a cikin fayil da nake rabawa. A cikin Windows PowerShell, aika wannan JSON da Invoke-RestMethod -ContentType "application/json; charset=utf-8" -Body, kada ka aika shi a matsayin hujja ga curl.exe ko wani shiri: Windows PowerShell 5.1 yana karya alamar zance na hujjar da shiri ke samu.
alongside: Kowane umarni ya fara duba duk haɗin da saitunanka suka riƙe a adireshin wannan Leafen, ko menene sunansa: wanda Leafen har yanzu yake karɓar maɓallinsa don dukan wuraren aikina, a matsayina, kamar yadda haɗin wannan rubutun zai isa gare su (yana tambayar Leafen da wannan maɓalli, wanda ba ya bayyana), ana kiyaye shi — sannan ba ya musanya komai, ya faɗi wanene, kuma lambar ta kasance ba a yi amfani da ita ba; wannan sunan yana wakiltar {{name}} a cikin layukan da ke ƙasa. Ba a taɓa kiyaye haɗin wani mutum a cikin saituna ɗaya. Sai kawai idan babu wanda ke aiki yake ƙara Leafen: a matsayin {{name}} ko, idan saitunanka suna riƙe da uwar garke mai wannan suna tuni — haɗin wani mutum, ko na baya — a gefensa a matsayin {{beside}}, yana faɗin wanene; wannan sunan yana wakiltar {{name}} a cikin layukan da ke ƙasa. A cikin saitunana, Leafen yana lissafin haɗin da shirinka da wannan kwamfuta. Kada ka taɓa cirewa ko rubuta haɗi da kanka, har ma da na wannan Leafen. Idan Leafen ya shiga gefen ɗaya, gaya mani haka a cikin jumla ɗaya; umarnin yana ambaton waɗanda Leafen ya ƙi maɓallinsu: tambaye ni sau ɗaya ko in cire su, haka ma ga wani haɗina na baya zuwa wannan Leafen da ba za ka sake amfani da shi ba. Sai da amincewata kawai, cire shi: yayin da maɓallinsa ke aiki a nan, fara cire haɗin da wannan maɓalli — DELETE zuwa origin na adireshinsa + /api/leafen/v1/mcp/connections/current, ana karanta kan sa daga saitunanka kamar yadda ke ƙasa kuma ba a taɓa buga shi ba —, sannan cire shi daga saitunanka (Claude Code: mcp remove da sunansa da --scope user; Codex: teburinsa na [mcp_servers.<its name>]). Haɗin wani mutum, ko na wani Leafen, wanda ke aiki yana kasancewa yadda yake. Idan an ɗauki dukkan sunayen biyu ba ya musanya komai kuma lambar ta kasance ba a yi amfani da ita ba.
keyLine: Maɓallin yana aiki a matsayina, da izinina — duk abin da zan iya yi a Leafen, a dukan wuraren aikina — har zuwa {{date}}; ka gaya mini kafin lokacin don in sake ƙirƙirar shi.
chatApps: Idan ba za ka iya gudanar da umarni ba (Claude.ai, ChatGPT da sauran aikace-aikacen tattaunawa), gaya mini in ƙara mai haɗi da adireshin daga ko'ina — a cikin Claude, Keɓance → Masu haɗi → Ƙara → Ƙara mai haɗi na musamman; a cikin ChatGPT, Filogi → + → Ƙara sabar MCP na musamman — kuma in shiga lokacin da Leafen ya tambaya. A kan shirin Team ko Enterprise, mamallakin ƙungiyar ne zai fara ƙara shi.
chatAppsClaudePort: Amma wannan adireshi yana amfani da port {{port}}, kuma masu haɗin Claude na musamman suna haɗawa ne kawai da adireshin https marar port (443), don haka mai haɗin Claude ba zai iya haɗawa da shi ba. Idan kai Claude ne a cikin hira kuma za ka haɗa ta mai haɗi, gaya mini haka kawai: mai haɗin ne kawai ba ya aiki, kuma burauza, manhajoji da wakilai irin su Claude Code suna haɗawa da wannan adireshi yadda yake. Don mai haɗi, ina bukatar Tailscale na Leafen (adireshin jama'a kyauta), tunnel ɗin Cloudflare na kaina, ko adireshin da aka buɗe a kan port 443.
instructionFile: Idan fayil ɗin umarninka ya riga ya ƙunshi layukan <!-- leafen:begin --> … <!-- leafen:end -->, saka waɗannan a wurinsu, don ya riƙe yanki ɗaya kawai. Ƙara waɗannan layukan, da adireshin kawai ba tare da maɓalli ba, cikin fayil ɗin umarninka na duk masu amfani (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md don Claude Code, ~/.codex/AGENTS.md don Codex, ko na wakilinka):
sameConversation: Bayan an ƙara shi, ci gaba a wannan tattaunawa — kada ka tura ni zuwa wata sabuwa. Sabar da aka ƙara yayin tattaunawa ba a ganinsa a cikinta nan take. Idan kayan aikin Leafen (leafen_…) ba su cikin naku tukuna: a cikin Claude Code a cikin terminal (CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT shine cli), ka tambaye ni da waɗannan kalmomi: “Don ci gaba a wannan tattaunawa, rubuta /reload-plugins a cikin akwatin saƙo, sannan aika ‘continue’.” Ba za ka iya gudanar da /reload-plugins da kanka ba, kuma ba ya fara amsarka ba: za ka ci gaba lokacin da na aika wannan kalmar, don haka kada ka taɓa cewa za ka ci gaba da zarar na rubuta ta. Sannan kayan aikin Leafen za su bayyana a nan. A wani wuri — Claude Code ba tare da terminal ba, kamar a cikin Claude app, ko Codex — ka kira MCP na Leafen ta HTTP da kanka, buƙatar JSON-RPC ɗaya a kowace kira, ana karanta header ɗin daga saitunanka kuma ba a taɓa buga shi (Claude Code):
httpHow: Da farko "method": "initialize" (params {"protocolVersion": "2025-11-25", "capabilities": {}, "clientInfo": {"name": "<your name>", "version": "1"}}) don abin da Leafen yake gaya maka, sannan "tools/list" don kayan aikinsa, sannan "tools/call" ga kowane ɗaya. Codex yana karanta kan sa daga teburin [mcp_servers.{{name}}] na config.toml ɗinsa haka. Daga tattaunawa ta gaba, kayan aikin Leafen naka ne.
startInChat: Sannan ka tambaye ni yadda za a fara: ta hanyar matsar da wurin aikina na Notion zuwa nan — ka gaya mini a cikin wannan tambayar yadda hakan zai gudana, da waɗannan kalmomi: “{{firstWords}}” — da kuma cewa idan na ce “matsa ni daga Notion”, za ka yi haɗin Notion a nan cikin wannan tattaunawa kuma; ko kuma daga wurin aiki mara komai. Idan na zaɓi matsawa, karanta jagorar ƙaura (leafen_notion_migration_guide), ka kira leafen_notion_migration_sources sannan ka bi ta.
notionMove: Ku gaya mini kuma cewa idan ina son canza tsari yayin motsawa daga Notion, sai in faɗa muku kawai.
connectedOnly: Sannan gaya mini a cikin jumla ɗaya cewa an haɗa ka kuma zan iya amfani da Leafen a wannan tattaunawa. Kada ka tambaye ni yadda zan fara ko ka ba da shawarar motsa wani abu zuwa nan; ka taimaka da abin da na tambaya.
oneFolderAlongside: Leafen yana shiga kowane babban fayil. Da zarar an ƙara shi, gaya mini haka, kuma cewa idan ina son shi a babban fayil ɗaya kawai, sai na faɗi haka. Sannan ka nemi sabon rubutu daga gare ni kuma ka gudanar da umarninsa a wannan babban fayil — don Claude Code tare da S=local a madadin S=user — sannan ka motsa layukan zuwa fayil ɗin umarnin babban fayil ɗin (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md). Haɗin na kowane babban fayil yana kasancewa gefen na babban fayil ɗin: tambaye ni sau ɗaya ko a cire shi, kamar yadda ke sama. Codex yana ƙarawa don kowane babban fayil, don haka a can layukan babban fayil ɗin kaɗai ke riƙe Leafen a cikinsa.
thisComputer: A haɗa kai da Leafen ta shirinsa a wannan kwamfuta: a gudanar da {{command}} kuma a yi abin da ya faɗa. Shirin shine {{mac}} don manhajar Mac, {{windows}} a cikin babban fayilinsa don manhajar Windows, {{docker}} don Docker, da {{source}} tare da --dir=<babban fayil ɗin bayanansa> daga tushe.
